ggchord_data.usage:
ggchord_data(sequences, features = list(), links = list(),
             tracks = list(), alignments = list())
ggchord_data.examples:
d <- ggchord_data(seqs,
  features = list(genes = genes), links = list(blast = links))
ggchord(d$sequences) + geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = d$features$genes) +
  geom_link_ribbon(data = d$links$blast)

layer_id.examples:
ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() +
  layer_id(geom_point(data = data.frame(x = 0, y = 0),
    aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE), "canvas_points")

coord_chord.usage:
coord_chord(
  start_angle = 0, direction = "counterclockwise",
  xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL, expand = FALSE,
  clip = "on", fit = "geometry"
)
coord_chord.examples:
ggchord(data = seqs) +
  geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = genes, aes(fill = type)) +
  geom_link_ribbon(data = links) +
  coord_chord(start_angle = 90)

coord_circular.usage:

  clip = "on", fit = "geometry"
)

  ratio = 1, xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL,
  expand = FALSE, clip = "on", fit = "geometry"
)
coord_dotplot.examples:
ggchord(data = seqs) +
  geom_alignment_segment(data = links, aes(colour = pident)) +
  layout_dotplot(x_order = "A", y_order = "B") +
  coord_dotplot(ratio = 1)

facet_null.examples:
ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() + geom_gene(data = genes) +
  coord_collinear() + facet_null()

facet_wrap.usage:
ggplot2::facet_wrap(
  facets, nrow = NULL, ncol = NULL, scales = "fixed", space = "fixed",
  shrink = TRUE, labeller = "label_value", as.table = TRUE,
  switch = deprecated(), drop = TRUE, dir = "h",
  strip.position = "top", axes = "margins", axis.labels = "all"
)
facet_wrap.examples:
# 每条序列一个圆形面板；两张表均明确包含accver
ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() + geom_gene(data = genes) +
  coord_circular() + facet_wrap(vars(accver))

facet_grid.usage:
ggplot2::facet_grid(
  rows = NULL, cols = NULL, scales = "fixed", space = "fixed",
  shrink = TRUE, labeller = "label_value", as.table = TRUE,
  switch = NULL, drop = TRUE, margins = FALSE,
  axes = "margins", axis.labels = "all", facets = deprecated()
)
facet_grid.examples:
g <- genes
g$sample <- c("s1", "s2", "s1")
ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() + geom_gene(data = g) +
  coord_collinear() + facet_grid(cols = vars(sample))

scale_fill_ggchord.examples:
ggchord(seqs) +
  geom_gene(aes(fill = type), data = genes) +
  scale_fill_ggchord()

scale_fill_plasmid.examples:
ggchord(seqs) +
  geom_feature(aes(fill = type), data = genes) +
  scale_fill_plasmid()

scale_colour_link_pident.examples:
hits <- transform(points[c(1, 1), ], qpos = c(200, 600), spos = c(220, 620),
  pident = c(84, 98))
ggchord(seqs) +
  geom_link_line(aes(colour = pident), data = hits) +
  scale_colour_link_pident()

scale_fill_signal.examples:
ggchord(seqs) +
  geom_track_point(aes(x = pos, y = value, fill = value), data = signal, shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_signal()

scale_colour_signal.examples:
ggchord(seqs) +
  geom_track_point(aes(x = pos, y = value, colour = value), data = signal) +
  scale_colour_signal()

fusion_magnify_auto.usage:
fusion_magnify_auto(overview = NULL, region,
  detail_coord = coord_collinear(), expand = 0, layout = NULL,
  guides = "collect", ..., detail = NULL, from = NULL, to = NULL,
  level = "auto")
fusion_magnify_auto.examples:
fusion_magnify_auto(zoom_overview, zoom_region, level = "feature", expand = 80,
  layout = layout_fusion_grid(ncol = 1))

cells <- head(flagship_fusion_example$base_cells, 24)
p <- ggplot(cells, aes(alignment_column, accver, label = symbol)) +
  geom_residue(aes(fill = symbol)) + scale_fill_residue("DNA") +
  coord_fixed() + theme_void()
p <- register_ggchord_alignment(p, cells)
region <- data.frame(accver = cells$source_accver[1],
  start = cells$source_position[9], end = cells$source_position[16])
fusion_magnify_auto(p, region, level = "residue", layout = layout_fusion_grid(ncol = 1))

setup:
library(ggplot2)
library(ggchord)

seqs <- data.frame(
  accver = c("A", "B"), length = c(1000, 800),
  sequence_unit = "bp", topology = "linear"
)
one_seq <- seqs[1, , drop = FALSE]
genes <- data.frame(
  accver = c("A", "A", "B"), feature_id = c("g1", "g2", "g3"),
  start = c(100, 400, 150), end = c(240, 620, 380),
  strand = c("+", "-", "+"), label = c("g1", "g2", "g3"),
  type = c("CDS", "tRNA", "CDS")
)
links <- data.frame(
  qaccver = "A", saccver = "B", qstart = c(100, 400),
  qend = c(240, 620), sstart = c(150, 450), send = c(290, 650),
  qstrand = "+", sstrand = c("+", "-"),
  pident = c(98, 90), link_id = c("l1", "l2")
)
points <- data.frame(qaccver = "A", qpos = 200, saccver = "B", spos = 220)
sites <- data.frame(accver = "A", pos = 300, site_id = "s1", label = "EcoRI")
signal <- data.frame(accver = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 3),
  pos = rep(c(100, 400, 700), 2), value = c(2, 5, 3, 1, 4, 2))
unordered_signal <- signal[c(1, 3, 2, 4, 6, 5), ]
intervals <- genes[c("accver", "start", "end")]
states <- genes[c("accver", "start", "end", "type")]
gene_colours <- c(CDS = "#187B77", tRNA = "#CC7D3A")
windows <- data.frame(accver = "A", start = 1, end = 500, window_id = "w1")
p_basic <- ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = genes) + coord_collinear()

label_seq <- data.frame(accver = "A", length = 1000, sequence_unit = "bp")
crowded_genes <- data.frame(
  accver = "A",
  feature_id = c("g1", "g2", "g3"),
  start = c(425, 478, 531),
  end = c(467, 520, 573),
  strand = "+",
  label = c("Gene alpha", "Gene beta", "Gene gamma")
)
label_plot <- ggchord(label_seq) +
  geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = crowded_genes, fill = "#187B77") +
  coord_collinear()

zoom_overview <- ggchord(data.frame(accver = "A", length = 1000)) +
  geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = data.frame(accver = "A", start = 380, end = 550, strand = "+")) +
  coord_collinear()
zoom_region <- data.frame(accver = "A", start = 380, end = 550)

nearby_links <- transform(links[c(1, 1, 1), ],
  qstart = c(100, 105, 400), qend = c(240, 245, 540),
  sstart = c(150, 155, 450), send = c(290, 295, 590),
  link_id = c("l1", "l2", "l3"))
